title: Area-code shard C pass 27 — 725 / 731 / 734

data.research_question: Which current or historically relevant public organizations, public professional actors, and communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 725, 731, and 734?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current NANPA geographic membership, literal and locality-derived web searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, public professional-role enumeration, and explicit uncertainty handling. X and Reddit discovery did not depend on official APIs.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational proximity, volunteering, attendance, membership, public role, or event participation.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
Public person-org relations are directly stated unless qualifiers explicitly mark an inference.
For overlay NPAs, locality association does not imply a published phone number unless directly evidenced.
Gated community spaces are not represented as public endpoints merely because their existence is mentioned publicly.

findings.notes: Las Vegas Liberation Foundation is current with weekly and monthly mutual-aid programs and public Instagram/email/Ko-fi/Linktree surfaces. Las Vegas DSA is current with August 2026 publication activity and an active first-party Mutual Aid Working Group. An older Las Vegas Food Not Bombs directory lead was not promoted without current first-party/status evidence.

Jackson Tennessee National Action Network maintains a live public chapter/contact surface and directly identifies founder Sabrina Parker. Operation: Restore is a current 2026 Jackson mutual-help/home-repair project with a directly published 731 call/text number and directly identified Founder & Chapter Lead Christopher Osburn. Neither organization nor either person is relabeled anarchist.

The Mutual Aid Network of Ypsilanti is current and explicitly describes mutual aid, solidarity, direct democracy, cooperation and collective liberation; this language is preserved without upgrading it to an anarchist self-description. Its public Signal announcement surface is distinguished from gated Discord/Loomio. Peace House Ypsi maintains a public 734 text line and Catholic Worker solidarity/nonviolent-resistance service surface. Historical Ann Arbor Food Not Bombs material remains a current-status lead rather than an active-org claim.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization and public-professional-role enumeration pass

summary: Bounded shard-C organization and public professional-role enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 725, 731, and 734.
